subject_reference_note: Every case opens with a catalog_lookup result naming the entities in scope by their canonical reference. Without it the excerpts name services in prose ('ledger-sync') while the labels use the reference form ('service:ledger-sync'), and the strategy tells a provider to use the reference exactly as it appeared in the data -- so eighteen of thirty cases carried subject labels no correct extraction could have produced. The lookup is added to all thirty rather than the eighteen that needed it, so its presence correlates with nothing. It reveals no predicate and no value: what it removes is the guessing of an identifier, which is a separate question from whether a claim was found.
